rule.en: Listen, then write it with the Pencil in the box — the standard form appears when you tap Done and the strokes are judged by rule; or write it on paper, show it, and rate it yourself or with a parent.

zh-char.q: 「你一定要照顾好自己。」中，"一定"的读音是？
zh-char.e: 一 changes tone depending on what comes after it. In front of a fourth-tone syllable like 定 (dìng), 一 is said in the second tone, so 一定 is yídìng.
zh-char.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期一，练习4（printed p.32）
zh-char.qe: How is 一定 pronounced in 「你一定要照顾好自己。」?
zh-char.ez: "一"的声调会随后面的字变化：后面是第四声（定 dìng）时，"一"读第二声，所以"一定"读 yídìng。

y.A: yīdìng keeps 一 in the first tone, which is how it sounds when you count — 一, 二, 三 — but not when it sits in front of a fourth-tone syllable.
y.B: yīdīng puts 定 in the first tone, but 定 is always a fourth tone, dìng, falling at the end of the word.
y.D: yìdīng has both tones the wrong way round: 一 is not a fourth tone here, and 定 is not a first tone.

yz.A: yīdìng 是"一"单独数数时的第一声（一、二、三），可是在第四声的字前面要变成第二声。
yz.B: yīdīng 把"定"读成了第一声，可"定"一直是第四声 dìng。
yz.D: yìdīng 两个声调都反了："一"在这里不读第四声，"定"也不读第一声。

zh-char.e: 突 is built from 穴 on top and 犬 underneath. 穴 takes five strokes and 犬 takes four, so 突 has nine in all, and the radical is the part on top, 穴 — the textbook prints 穴 → 突 beside the character list.
zh-char.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期一，练习4（printed p.32）
zh-char.qe: How many strokes does 突 have, and what is its radical?
zh-char.ez: "突"上面是"穴"，下面是"犬"。"穴"五画，"犬"四画，一共九画；部首是上面的"穴"——课本第50页写着"穴→突"。

y.B: 十；穴 picks the radical correctly but adds a stroke that is not there — 穴 is five strokes and 犬 is four, which comes to nine.
y.C: 九；犬 counts the strokes correctly, but 犬 is the part underneath; the radical of 突 is the 穴 above it.
y.D: 十；犬 misses twice over: the stroke count is nine, and the radical is 穴 rather than 犬.

yz.B: 十；穴 部首对了，但多数了一画："穴"五画加"犬"四画是九画。
yz.C: 九；犬 笔画数对了，可"犬"在下面，"突"的部首是上面的"穴"。
yz.D: 十；犬 两处都不对：九画，部首是"穴"。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：明天开会，你______不要迟到。
zh-word.e: 最好 is how you give someone friendly advice — you had best not be late. A reminder about tomorrow's meeting is a suggestion, not a command.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期一，练习4（printed p.32）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 明天开会，你______不要迟到。
zh-word.ez: "最好"用来给人提建议——你最好别迟到。提醒明天开会，是建议，不是命令。

y.A: 只好 means there is nothing else you can do, the way 小马只好回家问妈妈 — it describes being left with no choice, not being advised.
y.C: 原来 means it turns out, and it looks back at something just discovered rather than forward to tomorrow.
y.D: 都要 means all must, which needs a group of things to be about; only one person is being reminded here.

yz.A: "只好"是没有别的办法，像"小马只好回家问妈妈"，说的是没得选，不是提建议。
yz.C: "原来"是"原来如此"的意思，说的是刚弄明白的事，不是明天的事。
yz.D: "都要"是"全都必须"，要有一群人或一堆事才说得通；这里只提醒一个人。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：天快黑了，你______不要出去了。
zh-word.e: 最好 offers gentle advice — it is getting dark, so you had best stay in. The sentence suggests rather than orders.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期二，练习4（printed p.34）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 天快黑了，你______不要出去了。
zh-word.ez: "最好"是温和的建议——天快黑了，你还是别出去。这句话是劝，不是命令。

y.A: 只好 means no other option is left, but going out is still a choice here; she is being advised against it, not prevented.
y.B: 一定 would turn this into an order — you definitely must not go out — and the sentence is softer than that.
y.C: 突然 means something happened all at once, so it describes an event rather than what somebody should do.

yz.A: "只好"是没有别的办法，可这里出不出去还可以选，只是劝你别去。
yz.B: "一定"就成了命令——你绝对不能出去——这句话没那么重。
yz.C: "突然"说的是事情一下子发生，不是该做什么。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：老师进来了，教室______安静了。
zh-word.e: 突然 marks a change that happens all at once — the teacher walks in and the room goes quiet in that very moment.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期二，练习4（printed p.34）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 老师进来了，教室______安静了。
zh-word.ez: "突然"说一下子变了——老师一进来，教室一下就安静了。

y.B: 只好 means being left with no other option, but a classroom does not choose to go quiet; it simply does.
y.C: 最好 offers advice, and nobody is being advised — the sentence reports what happened when the teacher came in.
y.D: 一定 means certainly, which would say the room was bound to go quiet rather than describing the moment it did.

yz.B: "只好"是没有办法只能这样，可教室不会"选择"安静，它就是一下子安静了。
yz.C: "最好"是提建议，这句话没有在劝谁，只是说发生了什么。
yz.D: "一定"是"肯定会"，说的是必然，不是那一刻的变化。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：我没带雨伞，______等雨停之后再走。
zh-word.e: 只好 is for when every other option has gone. With no umbrella, waiting for the rain to stop is all that is left.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期二，练习4（printed p.34）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 我没带雨伞，______等雨停之后再走。
zh-word.ez: "只好"是别的办法都没有了。没带雨伞，只能等雨停。

y.A: 一定 means certainly, which would promise that she will wait rather than explain that she has no choice but to wait.
y.C: 突然 describes something happening all at once, and waiting for rain to stop is the opposite — it takes a while.
y.D: 最好 would make waiting the best idea among several, but with no umbrella it is the only idea.

yz.A: "一定"是"肯定会"，像在保证会等，而不是说没办法只能等。
yz.C: "突然"是一下子发生的事，等雨停正好相反——要等好一会儿。
yz.D: "最好"是几个办法里挑最好的，可没带伞，等雨停是唯一的办法。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：我______要早睡早起，这样才能身体好。
zh-word.e: 一定 is a firm promise to yourself — I will certainly keep early hours. The second half gives the reason, which makes the first half a resolution.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期二，练习4（printed p.34）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 我______要早睡早起，这样才能身体好。
zh-word.ez: "一定"是对自己下的决心——我肯定要早睡早起。后半句说了原因，所以前半句是决心。

y.A: 最好 would soften it into advice for somebody else, while this sentence is a promise the speaker makes about herself.
y.B: 突然 means all at once, which cannot describe a habit kept night after night.
y.D: 只好 means having no choice, but nobody is forcing these early nights — they are being chosen.

yz.A: "最好"变成在劝别人，可这句话是说话的人在给自己下决心。
yz.B: "突然"是一下子，不能用来说天天坚持的习惯。
yz.D: "只好"是没办法，可早睡早起是自己决定的，没人逼。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：小马不知道______怎么做。
zh-word.e: 应该 is for what someone ought to do. The pony has been given two opposite answers and cannot work out what he ought to do next.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期三，练习2（printed p.35）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 小马不知道______怎么做。
zh-word.ez: "应该"说的是该做什么。小马听了两种相反的话，不知道该怎么办。

y.A: 原来 means it turns out, and it introduces something just discovered rather than something one ought to do.
y.B: 既……也…… joins two things that are both true, so it needs two halves to join; this sentence has only one.
y.C: 小心 means careful, and the pony is not being careless — he simply does not know whose advice to follow.

yz.A: "原来"是刚弄明白的事，不是该做什么。
yz.B: "既……也……"把两件都对的事连起来，要两半才能用；这句话只有一半。
yz.C: "小心"是当心、仔细，小马不是不小心，是不知道该听谁的。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：下雨的时候走路要______一点儿。
zh-word.e: 小心 means careful. Wet ground is slippery, so walking in the rain asks for a little more care.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期三，练习2（printed p.35）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 下雨的时候走路要______一点儿。
zh-word.ez: "小心"是当心。下雨路滑，走路要更当心一点儿。

y.B: 应该 means ought to, and the 要 already in the sentence says that; what is missing is the word for being careful.
y.C: 原来 means it turns out, which looks back at a discovery rather than telling you how to walk.
y.D: 既……也…… links two things that are both true, and this sentence names only one thing to do.

yz.B: "应该"是"该"，句子里的"要"已经是这个意思了，缺的是"当心"这个词。
yz.C: "原来"说的是刚发现的事，不是教你怎么走路。
yz.D: "既……也……"连两件都对的事，这句话只说了一件要做的事。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：他______喜欢吃中国菜，______喜欢吃美国菜。
zh-word.e: 既……也…… joins two things that are both true at once. Notice that the sentence has two blanks and two halves — that is the shape this pattern is built to fill.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期三，练习2（printed p.35）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blanks: 他______喜欢吃中国菜，______喜欢吃美国菜。
zh-word.ez: "既……也……"把两件同时都对的事连起来。看，句子有两个空、两个半句——正是这个句式。

y.A: 小心 means careful, which has nothing to do with liking two kinds of food.
y.C: 应该 means ought to, but nobody is being told what to do — the sentence reports what he enjoys.
y.D: 原来 means it turns out, and it goes at the front of a single statement; it cannot stretch across two halves.

yz.A: "小心"是当心，和喜欢吃什么菜没关系。
yz.C: "应该"是该做什么，可这句话没人在要求谁，只是说他喜欢什么。
yz.D: "原来"放在一句话开头，说刚发现的事；它跨不了两个半句。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：亮亮长得很像你，______他是你的弟弟啊。
zh-word.e: 原来 marks the moment something clicks — he looks so much like you, and it turns out he is your younger brother. The 啊 at the end is the sound of working it out.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期三，练习2（printed p.35）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 亮亮长得很像你，______他是你的弟弟啊。
zh-word.ez: "原来"是忽然明白的那一下——他长得这么像你，原来是你弟弟。句尾的"啊"就是明白过来的语气。

y.A: 应该 means ought to, which would make the sentence tell him to be your brother — something nobody can be told.
y.B: 小心 means careful, and nothing here is risky.
y.D: 既……也…… joins two things that are both true, and this sentence is one discovery rather than two facts side by side.

yz.A: "应该"是该做什么，总不能要求他"该"当你的弟弟。
yz.B: "小心"是当心，这里没有什么要当心的。
yz.D: "既……也……"连两件都对的事，这句话是一个发现，不是两件事。

zh-word.q: 选择正确的答案填空：小马听了老牛的话，______要过河，小松鼠来了。
zh-word.e: 正 in front of a verb means right at that moment — he was just about to cross when the squirrel arrived. The story puts it the same way: 小马听了老牛的话，正要过河。
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期四，练习1（printed p.38）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 小马听了老牛的话，______要过河，小松鼠来了。
zh-word.ez: "正"放在动词前面，是"正要、刚要"——小马刚要过河，小松鼠就来了。课文里也是这么写的：小马听了老牛的话，正要过河。

y.A: 从 means from, and it needs a starting place after it, the way 从树上跳下来 does; it cannot sit in front of 要.
y.B: 到 means to or arrive, so it would need somewhere to arrive at — and the pony has not crossed yet.
y.D: 也 means too, which would say the pony crossed as well, as though somebody else had already crossed.

yz.A: "从"后面要跟一个地方，像"从树上跳下来"，不能直接放在"要"前面。
yz.B: "到"是到达，后面要有到的地方——小马还没过河呢。
yz.D: "也"是"也一样"，好像别人已经过了河，小马也过。

zh-word.q: 选择正确的答案填空：奶奶画了一张画儿，我______画了一张。
zh-word.e: 也 means too. Grandma drew one and I drew one too — two different people doing the same thing is exactly the job 也 does.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期四，练习1（printed p.38）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 奶奶画了一张画儿，我______画了一张。
zh-word.ez: "也"是"也一样"。奶奶画了一张，我也画了一张——两个人做同一件事，正是"也"。

y.B: 又 means doing something again, which needs the same person to draw twice; here the second drawing is by somebody else.
y.C: 既 does not stand on its own — it waits for 也 or 又 later in the sentence, as in 既……也…….
y.D: 才 means only then or not until, which would say the drawing came later than expected rather than as well.

yz.B: "又"是同一个人再做一次，可第二张画是另一个人画的。
yz.C: "既"不能单独用，它要等后面的"也"或"又"，像"既……也……"。
yz.D: "才"是"这才、直到……才"，说的是晚了才做，不是"也"。

zh-word.q: 选择正确的答案填空：水很浅，小马过______去。
zh-word.e: 得 links a verb to what is said about it: 过得去 means able to get across. The ox says it this way in the story — 水很浅，你过得去。
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期四，练习1（printed p.38）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 水很浅，小马过______去。
zh-word.ez: "得"接在动词后面，说能不能——"过得去"就是能过去。课文里老牛就是这么说的：水很浅，你过得去。

y.A: 的 joins a describing word to a noun, the way 美丽的花朵 does, so it needs a noun after it rather than 去.
y.B: 地 comes before a verb to say how it is done, like 小心地过河, but here the blank falls after 过.
y.D: 了 marks something finished, and the pony has not crossed yet — he is being told that he is able to.

yz.A: "的"连接形容词和名词，像"美丽的花朵"，后面要跟名词，不是"去"。
yz.B: "地"放在动词前面，说怎样做，像"小心地过河"；这里的空在"过"后面。
yz.D: "了"说事情做完了，可小马还没过河——是在说他能过去。

zh-word.q: 选择正确的答案填空：公园里有很多美丽______花朵。
zh-word.e: 的 ties a describing word to the noun it describes: 美丽的花朵, beautiful flowers.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》 星期四，练习1（printed p.38）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 公园里有很多美丽______花朵。
zh-word.ez: "的"把形容词和它形容的名词连起来：美丽的花朵。

y.B: 地 goes in front of a verb to say how something is done, like 慢慢地走, but 花朵 is a thing rather than an action.
y.C: 得 follows a verb to say how it turned out, as in 过得去, and 美丽 is not a verb.
y.D: 了 marks something completed, and nothing is being completed here — the flowers are simply there.

yz.B: "地"放在动词前面说怎样做，像"慢慢地走"，可"花朵"是东西，不是动作。
yz.C: "得"接在动词后面说结果，像"过得去"，"美丽"不是动词。
yz.D: "了"说做完了，这里没有什么做完的事——花朵就在那里。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：石柱上的小石狮子非常______。
zh-word.e: 生动 means lifelike, as if alive. The text says it of the little stone lions on the bridge: 它们都很生动，十分可爱.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期一，练习5（printed p.18）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 石柱上的小石狮子非常______。
zh-word.ez: "生动"是像活的一样。课文就是这么说桥上的小石狮子的：它们都很生动，十分可爱。

y.A: 中心 means center, the middle of a place; a lion cannot be 'very center'.
y.B: 景色 means scenery, the view of a whole place; one small lion is not a view, and 非常 needs a describing word.
y.D: 美丽 (beautiful) would read, but the sentence is the text's own line about the lions, and there they are 生动; in this exercise 美丽 is the word for the flowers, each word fitting one blank.

yz.A: "中心"是中间的地方，石狮子不能"非常中心"。
yz.B: "景色"是一整个地方的风景，一只小狮子不是风景；"非常"后面要跟形容词。
yz.D: "美丽"读得通，可这句是课文说石狮子的话——它们都很生动；这道题里"美丽"是说花的，四个词各填一空。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：北京颐和园的______可真好看啊！
zh-word.e: 景色 is scenery, the view. After 颐和园的 the sentence needs the thing that is good to look at, and the text ends on it: 颐和园到处都有美丽的景色.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期一，练习5（printed p.18）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 北京颐和园的______可真好看啊！
zh-word.ez: "景色"是风景。"颐和园的"后面要跟一样好看的东西，课文结尾就是：颐和园到处都有美丽的景色。

y.A: 美丽 (beautiful) is a describing word; after 的 the blank needs a noun — the thing that looks good.
y.C: 生动 (lifelike) describes a picture or a telling and is a describing word; the blank needs a noun.
y.D: 中心 is the center, a spot; 好看 (good to look at) is said of what you see, not of a position.

yz.A: "美丽"是形容词，"的"后面要跟名词——好看的那样东西。
yz.C: "生动"说画或讲课像活的一样，也是形容词；这里要填名词。
yz.D: "中心"是中间那个地方，"好看"说的是看到的东西，不是一个位置。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：草地上有很多______的花。
zh-word.e: 美丽 means beautiful, and it sits in front of 的花 the way 美丽的小岛 does in the text.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期一，练习5（printed p.18）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 草地上有很多______的花。
zh-word.ez: "美丽"是漂亮，放在"的花"前面，就像课文里的"美丽的小岛"。

y.B: 中心 is the center of a place; 很多中心的花 would be flowers of the center, and these are all over the grass.
y.C: 景色 is scenery, the whole view; it is not a quality one flower has.
y.D: 生动 is for things that seem alive in a picture or a story — a painted shrimp, a lively lesson — not for real flowers.

yz.B: "中心"是中间的地方，"很多中心的花"不通，花是长在草地上到处都有的。
yz.C: "景色"是一整片风景，不是一朵花的样子。
yz.D: "生动"说画里的虾、讲的课像活的一样，不说真的花。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：广场的______有一群人正在跳舞。
zh-word.e: 中心 means center. People dance in a place, and 广场的中心 is the middle of the square — like 湖中心 in the text.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期一，练习5（printed p.18）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 广场的______有一群人正在跳舞。
zh-word.ez: "中心"是中间。跳舞要在一个地方，"广场的中心"就是广场中间，像课文里的"湖中心"。

y.A: 生动 (lifelike) is a describing word and cannot be the place where people dance.
y.B: 景色 is scenery, something you look at; people dance in a spot on the square, not in its view.
y.C: 美丽 (beautiful) is a describing word; 广场的______ needs a place — a noun.

yz.A: "生动"是形容词，不能当跳舞的地方。
yz.B: "景色"是看的风景，人是在广场的一个地方跳舞，不是在风景里。
yz.C: "美丽"是形容词，"广场的"后面要跟一个地方。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：走进颐和园的东门，就能见到昆明湖。湖中心有个美丽的______。
zh-word.e: 小岛 is a small island. The text says what is in the middle of the lake: 湖中心有个美丽的小岛.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期四，练习1（printed p.24）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 走进颐和园的东门，就能见到昆明湖。湖中心有个美丽的______。
zh-word.ez: "小岛"是湖里的小陆地。课文说湖中心有什么：湖中心有个美丽的小岛。

y.A: 景色 is scenery; 个 counts a thing, and the thing in the middle of the lake is an island.
y.C: 长廊, the long corridor, comes after the lake in the text, at the foot of 万寿山 — not in the water.
y.D: 石柱, the stone pillars, stand on the two sides of the bridge, not in the lake's center.

yz.A: "景色"是风景，"个"要数一样东西，湖中心的东西是小岛。
yz.C: "长廊"在课文里是走完湖以后的，在万寿山脚下，不在水里。
yz.D: "石柱"在桥两边，不在湖中心。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。桥两边的______上有很多小石狮子。
zh-word.e: 石柱 means stone pillars. The lions stand on them: 桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期四，练习1（printed p.24）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。桥两边的______上有很多小石狮子。
zh-word.ez: "石柱"是石头柱子。小石狮子就在上面：桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。

y.A: 小岛 is the island in the lake; the lions stand at the two sides of the bridge, on its pillars.
y.C: 长廊 comes later in the text, after the bridge; what stands at the bridge's sides is 石柱.
y.D: 景色 is scenery; a lion cannot stand on a view, and 上 needs a solid thing.

yz.A: "小岛"在湖中心，小狮子在桥两边的柱子上。
yz.C: "长廊"是课文里过了桥以后才到的，桥两边立着的是石柱。
yz.D: "景色"是风景，狮子不能站在风景"上"。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。它们都很______，十分可爱。
zh-word.e: 生动 means lifelike. 很 needs a describing word, and the text says exactly this of the lions: 它们都很生动，十分可爱.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期四，练习1（printed p.24）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。它们都很______，十分可爱。
zh-word.ez: "生动"是像活的一样。"很"后面要跟形容词，课文说小狮子就是这句：它们都很生动，十分可爱。

y.B: 景色 is a thing — scenery — and 很 needs a describing word; 很景色 does not work.
y.C: 石柱 is a thing, the pillars the lions stand on; it cannot follow 很.
y.D: 小岛 is a thing, the island; it cannot follow 很.

yz.B: "景色"是名词，"很"后面要跟形容词，"很景色"不通。
yz.C: "石柱"是东西，是狮子站的柱子，不能放在"很"后面。
yz.D: "小岛"是东西，不能放在"很"后面。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：走在著名的长廊上，一眼望不到头。走完______，登上万寿山，颐和园的景色尽收眼底。
zh-word.e: 长廊 is the long corridor. You walk to the end of it and reach the hill: 走完长廊，就来到了万寿山脚下.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期四，练习1（printed p.24）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 走在著名的长廊上，一眼望不到头。走完______，登上万寿山，颐和园的景色尽收眼底。
zh-word.ez: "长廊"是长长的走廊。走完它就到山脚下了：走完长廊，就来到了万寿山脚下。

y.A: 石柱 is a pillar; you cannot 走完 (walk to the end of) a pillar.
y.B: 小岛 is the island in the lake, reached over the bridge; what you walk through before the hill is the corridor.
y.D: 生动 is a describing word; 走完 needs a place you can walk through.

yz.A: "石柱"是柱子，柱子没法"走完"。
yz.B: "小岛"在湖中心，过桥才到；上山前走完的是长廊。
yz.D: "生动"是形容词，"走完"后面要跟能走的地方。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：颐和园到处都有美丽的______，让人十分难忘。
zh-word.e: 景色 means scenery. The text's last line: 颐和园到处都有美丽的景色，让人十分难忘.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第三课《颐和园》 星期四，练习1（printed p.24）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 颐和园到处都有美丽的______，让人十分难忘。
zh-word.ez: "景色"是风景。课文最后一句：颐和园到处都有美丽的景色，让人十分难忘。

y.A: 长廊 is one corridor; 到处 (everywhere) wants something found all over the park.
y.B: 生动 is a describing word; 美丽的 needs a noun after it.
y.D: 小岛 is one island in the lake, not islands everywhere.

yz.A: "长廊"只有一条，"到处"要的是园子里到处都有的东西。
yz.B: "生动"是形容词，"美丽的"后面要跟名词。
yz.D: "小岛"只有湖中心一个，不是到处都有。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：他告诉了我一件有意思的______。
zh-word.e: 事情 means a matter, something that happened. 一件 counts matters, and that is what one person tells another — 一件有意思的事情.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期二，练习3（printed p.20）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 他告诉了我一件有意思的______。
zh-word.ez: "事情"是发生的事。"一件"数的是事情，告诉别人的也是事情——一件有意思的事情。

y.A: 抬头 is an action, raising your head; you cannot be told a head-raise, and 一件 does not count actions.
y.C: 旁边 means beside, a place; after 一件有意思的 the sentence needs the thing he told.
y.D: 茂盛 (lush) describes leaves and trees, and it is a describing word, not something to be told.

yz.A: "抬头"是一个动作，不能被"告诉"，"一件"也不数动作。
yz.C: "旁边"是一个位置，"一件有意思的"后面要跟他告诉我的那件事。
yz.D: "茂盛"说树叶长得多，是形容词，不是能告诉人的事。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：我站在妈妈的______。
zh-word.e: 旁边 means beside. 站在……的 needs a place, and the picture shows the girl at her mother's side — 我站在妈妈的旁边.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期二，练习3（printed p.20）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 我站在妈妈的______。
zh-word.ez: "旁边"是靠着的地方。"站在……的"后面要跟一个位置，图上小女孩就站在妈妈身边——我站在妈妈的旁边。

y.A: 事情 is a matter, something that happens; you cannot stand in a matter.
y.B: 抬头 is an action; after 妈妈的 the sentence needs where I stand.
y.C: 茂盛 describes plants growing thickly; it is not a place.

yz.A: "事情"是发生的事，人不能站在事情里。
yz.B: "抬头"是动作，"妈妈的"后面要跟我站的位置。
yz.C: "茂盛"说草木长得好，不是位置。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：这里的树长得真______！
zh-word.e: 茂盛 means lush, growing thick and full. 长得真 asks how the trees grow, as the text says of the garden's trees — 茂盛的枝叶.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期二，练习3（printed p.20）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 这里的树长得真______！
zh-word.ez: "茂盛"是长得又多又好。"长得真"问的是树长得怎么样，课文也这么说园子里的树——茂盛的枝叶。

y.B: 事情 is a noun, a matter; 真 needs a describing word.
y.C: 旁边 is a place; 长得真 asks what the trees look like, not where they are.
y.D: 抬头 is raising one's head; a tree has no head to raise, and 真 wants a quality.

yz.B: "事情"是名词，"真"后面要跟形容词。
yz.C: "旁边"是位置，"长得真"问的是树的样子，不是在哪儿。
yz.D: "抬头"是人的动作，树没有头可抬，"真"后面要跟形容词。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：我站在窗边______看，夜空中有许多美丽的小星星。
zh-word.e: 抬头 means to lift your head. The stars are up in the night sky, so you look up — 抬头看.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期二，练习3（printed p.20）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 我站在窗边______看，夜空中有许多美丽的小星星。
zh-word.ez: "抬头"是把头抬起来。星星在夜空里，要往上看——抬头看。

y.A: 旁边 is a place and would need 在 before it; between 站在窗边 and 看 the sentence needs what I do to see the sky.
y.B: 茂盛 describes thick leaves; it has nothing to do with looking at stars.
y.D: 事情 is a noun, a matter; the blank needs an action done before 看.

yz.A: "旁边"是位置，前面还得有"在"；"站在窗边"和"看"中间要填看天的动作。
yz.B: "茂盛"说树叶多，和看星星没关系。
yz.D: "事情"是名词，这里要填"看"前面的动作。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：骆驼长得高，一______就吃到了树叶。
zh-word.e: 抬头 is lifting the head. The camel is tall, so one lift of the head reaches the leaves — the text's own line: 骆驼一抬头就吃到了树叶.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期四，练习2（printed p.25）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 骆驼长得高，一______就吃到了树叶。
zh-word.ez: "抬头"是把头抬起来。骆驼高，一抬头就够到树叶了——课文原句：骆驼一抬头就吃到了树叶。

y.B: 进去 means go in; the camel is outside the wall and eats by lifting its head, not by going in.
y.C: 又窄又矮 (narrow and low) describes the door; it is not something the camel does.
y.D: 脖子 is a neck, a thing; after 一 the sentence needs an action done once.

yz.B: "进去"是走进去，骆驼在墙外，是抬头吃到的，不是进去吃。
yz.C: "又窄又矮"说的是门，不是骆驼做的事。
yz.D: "脖子"是东西，"一"后面要跟一个动作。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：羊长得矮，伸长______也吃不到树叶。
zh-word.e: 脖子 is the neck. 伸长 (stretch out) needs a body part, and the text says 脖子伸得老长，还是吃不着.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期四，练习2（printed p.25）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 羊长得矮，伸长______也吃不到树叶。
zh-word.ez: "脖子"就是颈。"伸长"后面要跟身体的一部分，课文说：脖子伸得老长，还是吃不着。

y.A: 进去 is going in; you cannot stretch it.
y.B: 又窄又矮 describes the door; nothing narrow and low gets stretched here.
y.D: 抬头 is already a whole action; 伸长 needs the part of the body being stretched.

yz.A: "进去"是动作，不能"伸长"。
yz.B: "又窄又矮"说的是门，这里没有又窄又矮的东西可以伸长。
yz.D: "抬头"本身就是一个动作，"伸长"后面要跟伸长的身体部位。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：但是，羊可以走进______的门，骆驼却钻不进去。
zh-word.e: 又窄又矮 means narrow and low. Before 的门 the sentence needs words that describe the door, and that is how the text describes it: 又窄又矮的门.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期四，练习2（printed p.25）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 但是，羊可以走进______的门，骆驼却钻不进去。
zh-word.ez: "又窄又矮"说门不宽也不高。"的门"前面要填说门的词，课文就是这么说的：又窄又矮的门。

y.A: 脖子的门 would be a neck's door; the blank describes what the door is like.
y.B: 抬头 is an action, raising the head; it cannot describe a door.
y.D: 进去 is an action, and 走进 already says going in; what is missing is what the door is like.

yz.A: "脖子的门"不通，这里要填门是什么样的。
yz.B: "抬头"是动作，不能说门。
yz.D: "进去"是动作，"走进"已经说了进去，缺的是门的样子。

zh-word.q: 选词填空：羊可以走进又窄又矮的门，骆驼却钻不______。
zh-word.e: 进去 means get in. 钻不进去 is cannot squeeze in — the text's words for the camel at the door: 怎么也钻不进去.
zh-word.src: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第四课《骆驼和羊》 星期四，练习2（printed p.25）
zh-word.qe: Fill the blank: 羊可以走进又窄又矮的门，骆驼却钻不______。
zh-word.ez: "进去"是进到里面。"钻不进去"就是钻不进门——课文说骆驼：怎么也钻不进去。

y.A: 又窄又矮 describes the door, not whether the camel gets through it.
y.B: 钻不脖子 means nothing; after 钻不 comes the result — in or not.
y.D: 抬头 is a different action, lifting the head; after 钻不 comes whether the squeeze got through.

yz.A: "又窄又矮"说的是门，不是骆驼钻没钻进去。
yz.B: "钻不脖子"不通，"钻不"后面要跟结果——进去没有。
yz.D: "抬头"是另一个动作，"钻不"后面要说钻的结果。

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.en: 颐和园 — yí, the Summer Palace.
很久 — jiǔ, a long time.
站着 — zhàn, standing.
小桥 — qiáo, a small bridge.
长廊 — láng, the long corridor.
眼睛 — yǎn, eye.
长寿 — shòu, long life.
收到 — shōu, receive.

exercises.title: 左右结构、半包围结构，还是独体字？
exercises.title_en: Left–right, half-enclosed, or a single-body character?

explanation.zh: 臣在左、页在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 臣 on the left, 页 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 久不能拆成两部分：独体字。
explanation.en: 久 cannot be split into parts: a single-body character.

explanation.zh: 立在左、占在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 立 on the left, 占 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 木在左、乔在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 木 on the left, 乔 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 广从上面和左面包住郎：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 广 wraps 郎 from the top and the left: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 目在左、艮在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 目 on the left, 艮 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 丩在左、攵在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 丩 on the left, 攵 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 根据图片提示写汉字
exercises.title_en: Use the picture clues to write characters

note.zh: 图在练习册第17页，四张：左上、右上、左下、右下。看图和拼音，写出那个字。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 17: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. Look at the picture and the pinyin, and write the character.

explanation.en: The picture shows two feet: 脚 jiǎo.

explanation.zh: 图上是一座有很多桥洞的桥：桥 qiáo。
explanation.en: The picture shows a bridge with many arches: 桥 qiáo.
The picture shows a stone lion: 狮 shī.

explanation.zh: 图上是一只眼睛：眼 yǎn。
explanation.en: The picture shows an eye: 眼 yǎn.

exercises.title: 连一连，写一写
exercises.title_en: Match and write

note.zh: 先点上面的部件，再点下面能和它合成字的那一半。课本已连好一组：立—占。
note.en: Tap a part on the top row, then the half below that makes a character with it. The book has drawn one line already: 立—占.

explanation.en: 氵 and 同 make 洞.
木 and 乔 make 桥.
广 and 郎 make 廊.

explanation.zh: 立和占合成"站"——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 立 and 占 make 站 — the book's own example.

exercises.title: 连一连，写一写：把字写出来
exercises.title_en: Match and write: write the characters

explanation.en: 立 on the left, 占 on the right: 站.
氵 on the left, 同 on the right: 洞.
木 on the left, 乔 on the right: 桥.

explanation.zh: 广在上面和左面，郎在里面：廊。
explanation.en: 广 over the top and down the left, 郎 inside: 廊.

exercises.title: 读一读，组词语
exercises.title_en: Read and form words

note.zh: 两个字读音相近，各组一个词。
note.en: The two sound alike; make one word with each.

exercises.title: 根据拼音写词语，并填在合适的句子中
exercises.title_en: Write the words below Pinyin and fill in the appropriate sentences

note.zh: 五个拼音：zhōngxīn　jǐngsè　lǜsè　zhōngyú　xiǎodǎo。想出是哪五个词，把合适的那个写进句子的格子里；第（2）句要填两个。
note.en: Five pinyin words: zhōngxīn, jǐngsè, lǜsè, zhōngyú, xiǎodǎo. Work out the five words and write the one that fits into each sentence's cells; sentence (2) takes two.

items.prompt_en: (2) 你快看，湖＿＿还有一个＿＿！ (two words)

items.prompt: （4）这次作文比赛，我＿＿取得了第一名。
items.prompt_en: (4) 这次作文比赛，我＿＿取得了第一名。

exercises.title: 照例子，用"终于"完成句子
exercises.title_en: Follow the example to complete the sentences with "zhōngyú"

items.prompt: 例：今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。（1）＿＿，＿＿终于＿＿。
items.prompt_en: Example: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。 (1) …，…终于…。

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：我终于来到了颐和园。
explanation.en: In order: 我终于来到了颐和园 — I finally arrived at the Summer Palace.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：颐和园的景色十分美丽。
explanation.en: In order: 颐和园的景色十分美丽 — the Summer Palace's scenery is very beautiful.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：湖中心有个小岛。
explanation.en: In order: 湖中心有个小岛 — in the middle of the lake there is an island.

exercises.title: 请用中文写出你周末想要去的五个地方
exercises.title_en: List five places you want to visit on weekends in Chinese

note.zh: 例：体育活动中心。
note.en: Example: 体育活动中心.

exercises.title: 读一读
exercises.title_en: Read aloud

note.zh: 读出来，录下来就行，不打分。对照在批改的时候看。
note.en: Just read it aloud; it is recorded, not scored. The comparison is for the evaluation.

exercises.text:
中心 湖中心 广场中心 文化中心
十分美丽 十分生动 十分可爱 十分难忘
绿色 红色 白色 蓝色
小桥 孔桥 桥洞 一座桥

exercises.title: 根据句子选择正确的图片
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct pictures for the sentences

note.zh: 四张图在练习册第22页，标着A、B、C、D。先点句子，再点它说的那张图。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 22, lettered A to D. Tap a sentence, then the picture it describes.

left: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。
从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。
桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。
走在著名的长廊上，绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆，一眼望不到头。

items.left: 今年寒假，我终于来到了向往已久的颐和园。

explanation.zh: 来到颐和园——图D是挂着"颐和园"牌子的大门。
explanation.en: Arriving at the Summer Palace — picture D is the gate with the 颐和园 plaque.

items.left: 从湖边到湖中心的小岛，要走过十七孔桥。

explanation.zh: 十七孔桥——图C是有很多桥洞的长石桥。
explanation.en: The Seventeen-Arch Bridge — picture C is the long stone bridge with many arches.

items.left: 桥两边的石柱上有很多小石狮子。

explanation.en: The little stone lions on the pillars — picture A.

items.left: 走在著名的长廊上，绿色的柱子，红色的栏杆，一眼望不到头。

explanation.en: The long corridor with green pillars and red railings — picture B.

exercises.title: 读课文，回答问题
exercises.title_en: Read the text and answer the questions

items.prompt_en: (1) Where did the writer go this winter vacation?
(2) Going in by the east gate, what did the writer see?
(3) What is in the middle of the lake?

items.prompt: （4）十七孔桥两边的石柱上有什么？
items.prompt_en: (4) What is on the stone pillars at the two sides of the Seventeen-Arch Bridge?

exercises.title: 选择相应的语句补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct expressions to complete the dialogue

note.zh: 对话里缺了四句，看练习册第25页的地图选。
note.en: Four lines are missing; use the map on workbook p. 25 to choose.

options: 你先向前走，第一个路口左转

items.before: 大卫：______，我想问一下，去学校怎么走？

explanation.zh: 开口问路先打招呼：您好，我想问一下……
explanation.en: You greet before you ask the way: 您好，我想问一下…

items.before: 老王：我看看啊！我们在这里……　大卫：对。　老王：我知道了。______

explanation.zh: 老王告诉他去学校的路：你先向前走，第一个路口左转。地图上红线就是这么走的。
explanation.en: Lao Wang gives the way to the school: go straight first, then turn left at the first crossing — the red line on the map.

items.before: 大卫：好的。我还想买点儿东西，______？

explanation.zh: 想买东西，就问商场怎么走。
explanation.en: He wants to buy something, so he asks the way to the mall: 请问商场怎么走？

items.before: 老王：一直向前走就可以了。

explanation.en: After being shown the way, you thank the person: 谢谢您。

exercises.title: 听一听，根据问题判断句子正误
exercises.title_en: Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读一读练习册第82页第3课的听力文本（或放录音），听完再判断对错。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 3 listening script on workbook p. 82 (or play the recording), then mark each sentence.

explanation.en: The boy says 今天天气很好 — the weather is good.

explanation.zh: 男生说：我们去公园野餐吧！
explanation.en: The boy suggests it: 我们去公园野餐吧！

items.text: 他们没有去公园野餐，因为中午太热了。

explanation.zh: 女生说：好是好，但是中午太热了！所以改去看电影。
explanation.en: The girl says 中午太热了 — it is too hot at noon — so they change the plan to a movie.

explanation.zh: 男生说去看电影，女生说好啊，先去看看有没有票。
explanation.en: The boy proposes a movie and the girl agrees, if there are tickets.

exercises.title: 选词填空（1）：完、玩、晚
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (1)

note.zh: 三个字读音相近，每句用一个。点句子，再点填进去的字。
note.en: Three characters that sound alike, one per sentence. Tap a sentence, then the character that goes in it.

left: 爸爸，我想和你一起______游戏。

items.left: 爸爸，我想和你一起______游戏。

explanation.en: 玩游戏 — play a game: 玩.
这么晚了 — it is so late: 晚.

explanation.zh: 写完作业：完 wán，做完了。
explanation.en: 写完作业 — finished the homework: 完.

exercises.title: 选词填空（2）：坐、左、做
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (2)

explanation.en: 左边 — the left side: 左.
坐下来 — sit down: 坐.
怎么做 — how to do it: 做.

exercises.title: 选词填空（3）：狮、是、师
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks (3)
left: 动物园里的______子好可爱啊！

explanation.zh: 这位是我的妈妈：是 shì。
explanation.en: 这位是我的妈妈 — this is my mother: 是.

items.left: 动物园里的______子好可爱啊！

explanation.en: 狮子 — lion: 狮.
老师 — teacher: 师.

exercises.title: 介绍一个你最感兴趣的景点（四十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Write about a scenic spot that interests you the most, with more than 40 characters

note.zh: 提示：（1）你最想去的地方叫什么名字？（2）那个地方有什么景点？（3）有什么吸引你的地方？（4）你想和哪些人一起去？
note.en: Prompts: (1) What is the place you most want to visit called? (2) What is there to see? (3) What draws you to it? (4) Who would you go with?

items.prompt: 写一写这个景点（四十字以上）。
items.prompt_en: Write about the place (more than 40 characters).

blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写
exercises.title_en: Trace and write

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.en: 肯定 — kěn, certainly.
认输 — shū, admit defeat.
窄小 — zhǎi, narrow and small.
找人 — zhǎo, look for someone.
批评 — píng, criticize.

exercises.title: 上下结构，还是左右结构？
exercises.title_en: Top–bottom structure, or left–right?

explanation.zh: 止在上、月在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 止 above, 月 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 车在左、俞在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 车 on the left, 俞 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 穴在上、乍在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 穴 above, 乍 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 扌在左、戈在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 扌 on the left, 戈 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 讠在左、平在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 讠 on the left, 平 on the right: left–right.

exercises.title: 开动脑筋，找一找反义词
exercises.title_en: Think and find the opposite words

note.zh: 点左边的字，再点右边意思相反的字。课本已填好一个：大—小。
note.en: Tap a character on the left, then its opposite on the right. The book has filled one in: 大—小.

explanation.zh: 大的反义词是小——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: The opposite of 大 (big) is 小 (small) — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 高的反义词是矮：骆驼长得高，羊长得矮。
explanation.en: The opposite of 高 (tall) is 矮 (short): the camel is tall, the sheep is short.

explanation.zh: 宽的反义词是窄：又窄又矮的门。
explanation.en: The opposite of 宽 (wide) is 窄 (narrow), as in the narrow, low door.

explanation.zh: 赢的反义词是输：不肯认输。
explanation.en: The opposite of 赢 (win) is 输 (lose), as in 不肯认输.

explanation.zh: 长的反义词是短：长处和短处。
explanation.en: The opposite of 长 (long) is 短 (short), as in 长处 and 短处.

explanation.en: The radical of 跑 is 足, the foot.

explanation.zh: 矮的部首是矢——课本第39页写着"矢→矮"。
explanation.en: The radical of 矮 is 矢 — the textbook prints 矢 → 矮 on p. 39.

explanation.zh: 驼的部首是马，和骆一样。
explanation.en: The radical of 驼 is 马, like 骆.

Summer is hotter than winter: 夏天比冬天热.
Ten is bigger than five: 十比五大.
Ten is bigger than five, not smaller.

explanation.zh: 钅在左、占在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 钅 on the left, 占 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 矢在左、豆在右：左右结构。

note.zh: 一段话里缺了四句，第一空课本已填好：骆驼认为长得高好。按课文的顺序选。
note.en: Four lines are missing from the passage; the book has filled the first: 骆驼认为长得高好. Choose in the story's order.

options: 你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处，这是不对的

items.before: 有一天，骆驼和羊聊天。骆驼认为长得高好，______。

explanation.zh: 骆驼说高好，羊说的正相反：羊认为长得矮好。
explanation.en: The camel says tall is better; the sheep says the opposite — 羊认为长得矮好.

items.before: 于是，他们俩分别做了一件事证明自己是对的，谁______，

explanation.zh: 两件事做完，谁都不肯认输。
explanation.en: After both tests, neither would give in: 都不肯认输.

explanation.zh: 最后他们找了老牛评理。
explanation.en: In the end they went to the old ox to judge: 他们找了老牛评理.

explanation.zh: 老牛说的话：你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处，这是不对的。
explanation.en: The ox's words: you both see only your strengths and not your weaknesses, and that is wrong.

note.en: One character, two readings — a word for each. The book gives half of each pair: 长 zhǎng 长大; 盛 chéng 盛饭; 着 zháo 吃不着.

explanation.en: The first line of the text: 骆驼长得高，羊长得矮.

items.text: 羊能吃到围墙外的树叶。

explanation.zh: 羊抬起前腿，扒在墙上，脖子伸得老长，还是吃不着。
explanation.en: The sheep stands on the wall and stretches its neck, and still cannot reach: 还是吃不着.

items.text: 骆驼能钻进又窄又矮的门。

explanation.zh: 骆驼跪下前腿，低下头，往门里钻，怎么也钻不进去。
explanation.en: The camel kneels and lowers its head, and still cannot get through: 怎么也钻不进去.

items.text: 骆驼和羊都只看到了自己的长处。

explanation.zh: 老牛说：你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处。
explanation.en: The ox says so: 你们俩都只看到自己的长处，看不到自己的短处.

items.text: 他______出现在我面前，让我很惊喜。

河水既不像老牛说的那样浅，也不像松鼠说的那样深。

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：老牛一定会觉得河水很浅。
explanation.en: In order: 老牛一定会觉得河水很浅 — the ox would surely think the river is shallow.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：我一定会努力学习中文。
explanation.en: In order: 我一定会努力学习中文 — I will surely study Chinese hard.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：亮亮一定会帮妈妈做家务。
explanation.en: In order: 亮亮一定会帮妈妈做家务 — Liangliang will surely help Mother with the housework.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：妹妹一定会喜欢爸爸买的玩具。
explanation.en: In order: 妹妹一定会喜欢爸爸买的玩具 — Little sister will surely like the toy Father bought.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误

explanation.zh: 课文第一句就是：小马要过河。
explanation.en: The first line of the text: 小马要过河 — the pony wants to cross the river.

items.text: 老牛说水很浅，因为他又高又大。

explanation.zh: 老牛说"水很浅"；妈妈解释了原因：老牛又高又大，他会觉得水很浅。
explanation.en: The ox says the water is shallow, and Mother explains why: the ox is tall and big, so to him it feels shallow.

items.text: 小松鼠也认为很容易过河。

explanation.zh: 小松鼠说的正相反：别过河！水深得很，你会淹死的。
explanation.en: The squirrel says the opposite: don't cross — the water is very deep, you will drown.

items.text: 小马没有回家问妈妈的建议。

explanation.zh: 小马不知道该怎么办，只好回家问妈妈。
explanation.en: The pony did not know what to do, so he went home and asked his mother.

explanation.zh: 小马又跑到河边，小心地过了河。
explanation.en: The pony went back to the river and crossed it carefully.

exercises.title: 根据课文和图片给句子排序
exercises.title_en: Sequence the sentences according to the text and the pictures

note.zh: 图在练习册第37页；句子按故事先后排。
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p.37; put the sentences in the story's order.

pieces: 小松鼠从树上跳下来，告诉小马水很深，他会淹死的。
小马跑回家问妈妈，妈妈告诉他最好自己试一试。
小马又跑到河边，小心地过了河。
小马想要过河，牛伯伯告诉他水很浅，过得去。

explanation.zh: 故事的顺序：先问牛伯伯（①），松鼠跳下来（②），回家问妈妈（③），最后小心地过了河（④）。
explanation.en: The story's order: ask the ox first (①), the squirrel jumps down (②), home to ask Mother (③), then across the river carefully (④).

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text

items.prompt_en: (1) What does the pony want to do?

items.prompt: （2）牛伯伯为什么告诉小马水很浅，可以过河？
items.prompt_en: (2) Why does the ox tell the pony the water is shallow and he can cross?

items.prompt: （3）松鼠为什么说水深得很，小马会淹死的？
items.prompt_en: (3) Why does the squirrel say the water is very deep and the pony would drown?
(4) What does Mother think the pony should do?

exercises.title: 选择相应的句子补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences to complete the dialogue
options: 河水是深还是浅，最好你自己去试试。
小马，别过河！水深得很呢！你会淹死的！

items.before: 小马：牛伯伯，我要过河，水深吗？

explanation.zh: 老牛说的是：水很浅，你过得去。
explanation.en: The ox's line: 水很浅，你过得去 — the water is shallow, you can get across.

explanation.zh: 小松鼠说的是：小马，别过河！水深得很呢！你会淹死的！
explanation.en: The squirrel's line: don't cross — the water is very deep, you will drown!

items.before: （小马不知道怎么办，只好回家问妈妈。）

explanation.zh: 妈妈说的是：河水是深还是浅，最好你自己去试试。
explanation.en: Mother's line: is the river deep or shallow — best go and try for yourself.

exercises.title: 把故事讲给爸爸妈妈听，考考他们
exercises.title_en: Tell the story to your parents and test them

question.zh: 《小马过河》告诉了我们什么道理？
question.en: What does 小马过河 teach us?

note.zh: 把故事讲一遍，录下来；讲完问爸爸妈妈这个问题，再请他们点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: Tell the story and it is recorded; then ask your parents the question, and have them tap Listened.
